physicalNotes: No paper tabulates this K1V star's size or temperature in the work used here (Palma-Bifani et al. 2023 give only its spectral type and Gaia distance), so they are Gaia DR3's: the FLAME radius 1.0934 solar radii and mass 0.842 solar masses, and the GSP-Phot temperature 4878 K (4876 to 4881 K), catalogue model values from Gaia's photometry and parallax (Andrae et al. 2023; Creevey et al. 2023). 760,702 km at 695,700 km per solar radius; GM from 0.842 solar masses times the JPL solar GM. The orbit of AB Pic b placed here was fitted with a fixed total mass of 1.3 solar masses (Palma-Bifani et al. 2023). presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is measured on the sky.
